summary: Frontend-only validation of the dark-premium redesign + Industry builder background control wiring fix. All primary flows work: login (dark themed), admin dashboard (dark themed with Card Manager glass header), scan/inbox/analytics dialogs open, CardEditor tabs switch and all inputs (identity/contact/social/services/projects/booking) are editable, save persists with 'Card saved' toast, published toggle switches state, live preview updates as user types, industry builder's Background Intensity, Position and Opacity controls now visibly affect the preview card (verified via computed background-image alpha and background-position values), Activate + Legal pages render dark themed, /industries showcase renders, public /feras-askar Executive Black Gold profile regression passes. No console/pageerror on redesigned pages, no horizontal overflow at 1440 or 390.

ui_bugs.issue: position='full' maps to 'center' in IndustryCard.jsx (posX table), so the 'Full' button in the builder is visually indistinguishable from 'Center'. If 'Full' is intended to mean full-cover / centered-with-different-size, it needs a distinct implementation (e.g., different backgroundSize or backgroundPosition).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' on scan-dialog and leads-dialog. Non-blocking a11y warning.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Make position='full' behave differently from 'center' in IndustryCard (e.g., set backgroundSize:'cover' with a taller crop, or backgroundPosition:'center center'/'cover' distinctive) so users get a visible change when picking 'Full'.
OPTIONAL (a11y): Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ScanCardDialog and LeadsDialog to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: IndustryCard.jsx: position table {left,right,center,full:'center'} — 'full' option is a dead branch relative to center. Consider distinct behavior.

CardEditor tabs use text-based Tab labels (only tab-industry has data-testid). Adding tab-identity/contact/social/services/projects/booking testids would improve future automation, though spec only required tab-industry.

Frontend HTML body background is white on /login — visually dark themed container overlays it, but setting html/body background to #050607 in aria-dark scope would avoid any FOUC/white flash on slow networks.
seed_data_creation: During testing the /feras-askar card fullname was briefly changed to a TEST_ value and its published flag toggled off; both were RESTORED at the end of testing (fullname='Feras Askar', published=true). Public profile verified re-published and renders correctly. No residual TEST_ data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 verified the dark-premium redesign + intensity/position/opacity control wiring. Only cosmetic finding: position='full' is aliased to center (may or may not be intentional). All data-testids referenced in the review request were present and functional (except editor-contact-email, editor-booking, add-service, add-project which live behind their respective tabs — visible only after switching tabs, which is the expected behavior). Public profile /feras-askar was restored to published state after testing.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the requested scope. The reported dead-control bug for Background Intensity/Position was already fixed by main agent: IndustryCard.jsx now reads c.intensity (soft=1.3, medium=1, rich=0.68 alpha multiplier) and c.position (left=0%, center=50%, right=100%, full=50%), and industryCards.js previewCardConfig now forwards intensity/position/opacity from form state — confirmed to visibly change the computed backgroundImage alpha and backgroundPosition on [data-testid=ind-card-*] inside [data-testid=showcase-preview].
